title: HK roadshow: vendor map, receipts & reimburse flow (scratch)
content:
Quick notes + admin checklist for HK roadshow (working scratchpad)

Purpose: lightweight operational guide for myself + Ethan while running partner panels and customer dinners in Hong Kong. Keep short, actionable.

DAY-0: pre-flight (must-do)
- Confirm petty-cash float with Finance (request via slack #finance-ops) — target float HKD 5,000 for small reimbursements (food riders, last-minute venue snacks). Finance needs 5 business days to issue float.
- Push eSIM to team (Airalo/eSIM2Go) — one backup physical SIM (CSL/3) at HK airport vending machine.
- Upload expense policy snapshot to the shared folder (path: shared_drives/company/travel/hk-2026) and pin to #hk-roadshow channel.
- Make two copies of printed vendor list: one in binder, one in Maya’s bag.

VENDOR CONTACTS (Day-of priority)
- BrightLight AV (venue AV + quick on-site fixes) — contact: Raymond Lee, +852 9123 4567, WhatsApp: +85291234567, email: raymond@bl-av.hk. Code for invoice: INV-BL-0926, ask for line-itemed invoice with bank details.
- Harbour Catering (dinner cater & vegetarian options) — contact: Mei Chan, +852 9876 5432, email: mei@harbourcat.hk. Need menu + final headcount 48 by 48h prior. Ask for electronic tax invoice (e-invoice PDF) and bank remittance details.
- FastPrint HK (last-minute signage + badges) — contact: Alex Wong, +852 9345 7788, WhatsApp ok, on-site pickup 2-3 hours.
- Taxi alternative (minivan) — HongKong Tours Logistics, contact: Sam Kwan +852 9150 2233 (preferred for airport runs; invoice acceptable).

RECEIPT & INVOICE RULES (finance-friendly)
- Always get an itemized receipt/invoice with vendor name, date, amount and payment method.
- For catering and AV > HKD 2,000: request a PDF invoice with bank details and GST/VAT line (if present). Note: HK typically issues receipts; still accept PDF tax invoice or pro-forma invoice.
- Credit card statement screenshot + photo of receipt required for all corporate card transactions.
- Cash purchases: photograph both sides of the paper receipt where possible. If receipt illegible, ask vendor to reprint.
- Naming convention for uploaded receipts: YYYYMMDD_vendor_amount_HKG.
  Example: 20260315_HarbourCatering_4920_HKD.jpg

EXPENSE CAPTURE QUICK FLOW (for team)
1) Take photo (phone) immediately. Use OCR app (Receipts by Redwood or Expensify mobile) — run quick OCR to pre-fill amount/date.
2) Upload to shared drive folder: shared_drives/company/travel/hk-2026/receipts — subfolder by date.
3) Create expense in Expensify: attach photo, add GL code (TRV:GTM:HKG), add note: event name + attendee count.
4) Submit same-day or within 3 business days. For anything > HKD 2,000, flag as high-priority for finance review.

REIMBURSEMENT / PETTY CASH HANDOFF
- If using petty cash: reimburseee signs petty-cash log (hardcopy) and hands receipt to on-site coordinator (Lina). Coordinator uploads to drive and updates petty-cash spreadsheet (link in linked_artifacts).
- For bank reimbursements: finance needs original invoice + expense form + bank details. Encourage vendors to email PDF invoices directly to finance@redwood.com with reference HK-RD-<date>.

ON-SITE DAY-OF CHECKLIST (compact)
- Binder: printed guest list, name badges (pre-printed + blank for walk-ins), vendor contacts, backup chargers, HDMI adapters (US->HK plug and VGA adapter).
- Tech: confirm AV mic check at T-60 min, test Zoom link for hybrid guest, test streaming laptop (user: gm@redwood).
- Food: final headcount confirmation for Harbour Catering at T-48h. Allergy stickers for any boxed meals.
- Merch: hand out 2 merch boxes to venue host for emergency giveaways.

NAME BADGE + SIGNAGE NOTES
- Badges: stick-on lanyards; print attendee name line + company + role (short). Use color code for partners vs prospects.
- Signage: FastPrint to deliver 2x A1 directional boards and 6x A3 table tent cards. Confirm artwork 24h before print.

COMMUNICATIONS & ONCALL
- Slack: #hk-roadshow (pin vendor contacts and final agenda).
- On-call rotation: Maya (08:00–14:00), Ethan (14:00–20:00), Lina (backup). Keep phones on vibrate but check every 15 min during event windows.

OPEN / TODO (notes to self)
- Confirm whether Harbour Catering can do separate invoices per dinner table (for partner cost-share).
- Check expense code mapping with finance: is GL TRV:GTM:HKG correct or do we need tranche code?
- Add small note on currency rounding: convert receipts to USD at daily rate and include FX fee line on expense.
- Verify local COVID/vaccine documentation? currently not required but confirm 7 days prior in case rules change.

POST-EVENT WRAP (do within 5 business days)
- Collate all receipts, reconcile petty-cash, submit final expense report with spreadsheet + scanned invoices.
- Short event postmortem: 3 bullets (what worked, top 2 issues, one process change). Upload to Confluence page (linked_artifacts).

QUICK LINKS & REMINDERS
- Shared receipt folder: shared_drives/company/travel/hk-2026/receipts
- Petty cash sheet: shared_drives/company/finance/petty_cash/hk-roadshow-2026.xlsx
- Slack channel: #hk-roadshow
- Finance contact: Kevin Morales (Finance Ops), kevin.m@redwood.com — for urgent approvals.

Last notes: keep extraordinary expenses approval-first (anything > HKD 10,000 get prior written okay from Kevin). This doc is my running checklist; update in-flight and convert to a polished ops memo if we repeat this route.

-- Maya (working draft)
